title: Guidelines for representing your business on Google
measures: One profile per business; naming rules; hours and special hours; departments; individual practitioners (dentists named as an example), multiple practitioners at one location, and solo practitioners in branded organizations using the [brand]: [practitioner name] format.
limitations: Policy page; Google may change it without notice. Undated on the page.

title: Resolve duplicate profiles & ownership issues
measures: Why profiles are marked duplicate; duplicates do not show on Search or Maps; requesting ownership (3-day owner response window); appealing an incorrect duplicate status (signage evidence for shared locations); removing a mistaken duplicate removes its content and managers; merges via Maps suggestions combine reviews but replies may be lost; relocations and multiple services do not justify new profiles.
limitations: Help article; undated. Does not address practitioners who leave a practice.

title: Manage your Business Profile owners and managers
measures: Owner and manager roles, single primary owner, transferring primary ownership
limitations: Help page; no visible update date.

title: About keyword matching options
measures: Definitions of broad, phrase and exact match; broad is the default; broad may use recent searches, landing pages and other keywords; Google's note that Smart Bidding is critical with broad match; prioritisation of identical exact-match keywords over phrase, broad and Performance Max search themes.
limitations: Help article; matching behaviour and recommendations change over time. Google's recommendations reflect Google's view.

title: Your guide to broad match
measures: Google's stated benefits of broad match, how to convert keywords to broad, and the recommendation to pair broad match with Smart Bidding.
limitations: Promotional guidance from the platform; no independent performance evidence.

title: About the search terms report
measures: What the search terms report shows; Keyword and Match type columns; close variants; low-volume terms omitted for privacy; search terms insights themes.
limitations: Report shows only terms used by a significant number of people; not a complete query log.

title: How AI Max for Search campaigns works
measures: AI Max search term matching (broad match plus keywordless and landing-page technology), text customisation, final URL expansion, brand and URL controls, locations of interest; AI Max is not effective when limited by budget.
limitations: Feature set is new and changing; availability varies by account.

title: About negative keywords
measures: How negative broad, phrase and exact match work; negatives do not match close variants, so synonyms and singular/plural forms must be added; casing and misspellings are accounted for; the 16-word limit; symbols handling.
limitations: Help article; behaviour can change.

title: About negative keyword lists
measures: Shared negative keyword lists applied to multiple campaigns; up to 5,000 negatives per list and 20 lists per account; account-level limit of 1,000.
limitations: Limits stated on the retrieval date; may change.

title: About account-level negative keywords
measures: Account-level negatives apply to search and shopping inventory in Search, Performance Max, App, Shopping, Smart and Local campaigns; 1,000-keyword limit; no close-variant matching.
limitations: Help article; campaign-type coverage may change.

title: About Ad Scheduling
measures: Campaigns default to All day; schedules limit days and hours and allow bid adjustments; campaigns with ad schedules pace toward 30.4 times the average daily budget per month.
limitations: Help article.

title: About call assets
measures: Call assets can be scheduled to show only when the business can accept calls; call clicks cost the same as headline clicks; call reporting uses Google forwarding numbers; location assets may route calls to location numbers.
limitations: Help article; features vary by country.

title: About location assets
measures: Location assets use data sourced from Google Business Profile and Maps, including hours; locations marked temporarily or permanently closed do not show as location assets.
limitations: Help article.

title: About targeting geographic locations
measures: Presence versus location-of-interest targeting options
limitations: Help page; settings names may change.

title: Target ads to geographic locations
measures: How to set location and radius targeting; small radii may serve intermittently; Google recommends Presence or Interest but describes when Presence targeting makes sense.
limitations: Contains a Google-internal statistic for other verticals that is not applicable to dentistry and is not used.

title: Misrepresentation
measures: Policy prohibiting misleading or omitted material information, including unavailable offers: promising services or offers that are unavailable or not easily found from the destination.
limitations: Policy overview; enforcement detail is in linked sub-policies.

title: Measure calls from ads
measures: Call conversions counted by a minimum call duration or by AI analysis of call recordings; default Calls from ads action; requirements including call reporting and eligible countries.
limitations: Recording-based features raise privacy questions the practice should review with counsel; not addressed for healthcare on the page.

title: About overdelivery and your average daily budget
measures: A campaign may spend up to twice its average daily budget on a given day and no more than 30.4 times the average daily budget in a month.
limitations: Help article.

title: About bid strategy statuses
measures: Learning status lasts no more than 7 days and is triggered by a new strategy, composition change or conversion goal change; budget, target, creative and targeting changes do not trigger it.
limitations: Help article; Smart Bidding continues to adapt beyond the status label.

title: About Smart Bidding
measures: Smart Bidding requires conversion tracking; Google recommends evaluating over longer periods with at least 30 conversions; no need to segment by match type.
limitations: Platform guidance.

title: About Target CPA bidding
measures: Target CPA optimises toward a desired average cost per conversion; targets set too low can forgo conversions; recommended evaluation over periods with at least 30 conversions; bidding uses conversions included in the Conversions column.
limitations: Platform guidance; naming changed in June 2026.

title: About primary and secondary conversion actions
measures: Primary actions are used for bidding and reported in Conversions; secondary are observation-only; give Smart Bidding 1 to 2 conversion cycles after significant goal changes.
limitations: Help article.

title: About offline conversion imports
measures: Importing offline outcomes (such as office or phone conversions) back into Google Ads; Google recommends enhanced conversions for leads; 2026 API migration notes.
limitations: Implementation choices for healthcare data need privacy and legal review; the page does not address HIPAA.

title: Use Keyword Planner
measures: Keyword Planner gives estimates of searches and cost and performance forecasts; performance depends on bid, budget, ad quality, targeting and behaviour; sensitive or very low volume keywords are not forecastable.
limitations: Forecasts are estimates, not commitments.
